name: Gray
premise: gray-x's own wins not yet rescued (evolve + harness), verbatim

bits.text: My doctor's office reads my mind, but only while I'm on hold. I'm thinking about my rash and the voice says your call is important to us. I think about switching to the ob-gyn next door and the hold music skips a beat. One-sided telepathy. They know what I'm about to say before I say it, which is more than my wife manages.

Your doctor reads your chart and starts thinking at you. I caught the whole diagnosis before he said it out loud. Herniated disc, he's thinking. I'm thinking, yes, that's what WebMD said three weeks ago, Doug. One-sided telepathy is just a guy thinking while you nod. My wife does it in Target. I'm standing there holding a candle that smells like a fireplace and she's already divorcing me in her head.

The Preston ruling gave me a migraine that lasted nine days. My wife said it was stress. It was not stress, it was a legal precedent settling behind my eyes. Now every time I get a headache I check the docket. Last week it was just dehydration, but I filed it anyway.
You ever really look at a handshake? We do it at funerals, we do it at deals, we do it to say hello, and every single time it's the motion of begging a ketchup bottle for the last drop.

Every morning I brush my teeth with a stick that makes my mouth foam, then I spit the foam into a bowl attached to my face, and if I skip this ritual people say I look sick. I just want to make my mouth foam, and society built a whole personality test around it.
